authority_note: Primary accepted prior CT1 methodology/interpretation/candidate panel in current assignment; historical records retain their original status and bytes. No L1 or L3 authorization.

immutable_panel.preserve: Every ID, source hash, source row, archived actual x, held applied u, nominal x/u, packet/gain association and category. No replacement/reselection/rank-based exclusion.

operating_tuples.ACTUAL_HELD: Use archived actual x and physically held applied [delta,a_cmd] at original timestamp. Prior application source plan may differ from active authority; preserve both. Source physical curvature evaluated at actual s_abs.
operating_tuples.PACKET_NOMINAL: Use original immutable packet.sample(t) semantics at same physical time and original ZOH control/gain/preview index. Preserve original untrimmed design grid; accepted authority trimming is separately reconstructed.
operating_tuples.source_compare_only: When comparing methods, x,u,parameters,curvature policy, dt/substep schedule and chart must be identical. ACTUAL_HELD vs PACKET_NOMINAL differences are model/tuple effects, not derivative errors.

pipeline.action: Verify authorized CT1 parent, E4/E3/manifest, all 305 source bindings and 90 retained evidence hashes before import; original panel hash and exact candidate object SHA must match.
pipeline.failure: global preflight failure; no numerical worker or substitute source

pipeline.action: Bind native state row/time, held command via latest observed application, application-source packet, original accepted authority interval and packet expiry, original stored gain/gain_time/ZOH index, nominal reference, pending-command request lineage and prior applied delta.
pipeline.failure: UNAVAILABLE for genuinely absent pending-tail information; INVALID for contradictory chronology. Do not infer complete in-flight state from absence of a control row.

pipeline.action: Compute q(s) through accepted spline numerical-arc map; inspect exact source-bound polynomial derivatives and segment boundaries; calculate kappa, kappa_s in arc-length units, distinguish nominal preview and offset reference curvature.
pipeline.failure: UNAVAILABLE if no read-only pinned geometry binding, ambiguous segment or cannot resolve inversion/stencil branch; never fabricate dkappa/ds=0.

pipeline.action: Evaluate accepted diagnostics without time advancement; record speed, loads, sqrt arguments, slip/force/utilization, D, actuator boxes, corridor/slack/longitudinal margins; preserve source guard thresholds.
pipeline.failure: INVALID if actual source domain rejects; valid boundary without open neighborhood only branch-specific/unavailable derivative.

pipeline.action: Precheck fixed CT1 central stencils including every actual RK4 stage and endpoint, unwrapped heading residual chart, positive unwrapped progress and geometry branch; no shifted point, clipping, step shrinking, extra regularization or relaxed tolerances.
pipeline.failure: QUALIFIED_BRANCH_SPECIFIC only for an explicitly identified feasible side with one-sided derivative; central parity unavailable. Otherwise UNAVAILABLE. Record original tuple unchanged.

pipeline.action: Determine whether unsaturated immediate-memory-free A-BK assumptions apply. Flag box/slew branch, old applied delta, pending/delayed actuation, skipped grid, active/expired/superseded packet, nominal/actual mismatch and nonzero defects.
pipeline.failure: Does not erase an otherwise valid open-loop pair. Mark closed-loop conclusion conditional/UNAVAILABLE_ASYNC_EVENT_MAP; no hybrid-map implementation authorized.

pipeline.action: Emit all twelve candidates with per-tuple/per-map status, reasons, missing fields, inherited versus newly evaluated domain checks and category counts.
pipeline.failure: Retain INVALID/UNAVAILABLE/poor conditioning and all partial results; never reduce denominator from 12.

domain_thresholds.distinction: Plant admissibility and stricter NLP constraints are separate fields; no silent threshold merger. Even if source accepts roundoff at speed bounds, unrestricted central derivatives need a valid open neighborhood.
domain_thresholds.corridor: Record original widths, 0.08 m planning margin and scientific material-slack 1e-6 m gate; no swept-body safety inference.
domain_thresholds.sqrt: Both (mu*Fzi)^2-Fxi^2 strictly positive and all stencil stages retain longitudinal reserve; no epsilon inside sqrt.

geometry_and_chart_contract.read_only_binding: Proposed pinned access via ClosedTrack.centerline to PeriodicCenterline._spline.c, _q, _arc and _parameter(s); snapshot copies only, no monkeypatch or file edit. Private access must be explicitly reviewed at L1/L2.
geometry_and_chart_contract.tangent_domain: V must exceed accepted source 1e-8; no replacement geometry or raw-chord differentiation.
geometry_and_chart_contract.knot_handling: C2 spline gives continuous curvature but possibly distinct one-sided kappa_s at knots/seam. Preserve original s and explicit LEFT/RIGHT branch. No averaged derivative. Inversion/root uncertainty that prevents unique segment classification yields UNAVAILABLE; no new arbitrary knot tolerance. Record original inversion xtol=1e-12 and rtol=1e-13 plus quadrature epsabs/epsrel=1e-11 as source metadata, not proof error bounds.
geometry_and_chart_contract.map_crossing: Classify entire original and perturbed RK4 paths. If a required physical map crosses an unresolved knot/event/chart branch, report unavailable or explicitly branch-specific; do not substitute frozen geometry.
geometry_and_chart_contract.heading: Local lift of theta and endpoint residual; source plant wraps only completed steps. Do not finite-difference +/-pi values directly.
geometry_and_chart_contract.packet_boundary: Time and discrete packet/gain identity held fixed in x/u stencils; never interpolate IDs. An endpoint crossing authority, gain or input ZOH boundary gets explicit interval truncation, not a smooth time derivative.

status_rules.QUALIFIED: Source/causal binding valid; requested tuple/map has finite smooth two-sided domain, matching chart and required full stencils; feedback applicability classified independently.
status_rules.QUALIFIED_BRANCH_SPECIFIC: Original tuple retained, source domain valid and a named one-sided/nonsmooth branch interpretable; may emit that branch derivative, never unrestricted central parity or stability guarantee.
status_rules.UNAVAILABLE: Required record, differentiability certificate, map stage, chronology detail or branch resolution absent; preserve null result and exact missing reason.
status_rules.INVALID: Contradictory source/causal record, source rejects domain, or nonfinite/unphysical requested tuple; preserve values/reason, no shifted replacement.

conditioning_rule: Poor conditioning never changes candidate identity or deletes it. Retain QUALIFIED domain status with numerical INDETERMINATE conditioning status if applicable.
current_qualification: NOT EXECUTED; no point newly qualified by L0.
